records.evidence: Original PRO-sIPV-4001 protocol attachment located and downloaded. Scanned pages were not fully OCR-reviewed.
Exact PRO-sIPV-4001 SAP v1.0 downloaded and reviewed; plan availability is not a finding of analytic adequacy.

SAP plans overall power80%, serotype power93.3%, one-sided alpha0.025, control seroconversion90%, NI margin-10 percentage points;233/group inflated to360/group for dropout and failed blood collection.

SAP section7.9 specifies LOCF for missing FAS immunogenicity values and no imputation of missing safety values. These are planned methods, not proof that missingness is harmless. SAP section7.11 requires noninferiority for all three poliovirus serotypes jointly. It specifies no type-I adjustment under this intersection rule and allocates type-II error for overall80% power; no interim analysis planned.

Published exact-NCT trial:1442 infants randomized. C1/S1 seroconversion: typeI90.3%/87.0%, typeII91.7%/91.3%, typeIII86.4%/92.3%. Overall prespecified NI decision remains unadjudicated; subgroup rates alone do not establish success.

Publication uses a site-stratified CMH comparison and NI criterion: lower95% CI for seroconversion difference greater than-10 percentage points. The adjusted decision by all required serotypes is not resolved from the abstract.
Within7 days, adverse reactions were92.8% with coadministration versus95.5% with staggered vaccination. These are AR rates, not serious adverse event rates.
Seroconversion is an immunogenicity outcome, not direct clinical poliomyelitis-prevention efficacy.
Sabin-strain inactivated poliovirus vaccine supplies poliovirus antigen; an immune-response mechanism is distinct from clinical protection.
Original PRO-QINF-3005 protocol attachment located and reviewed for exact study identity.
Exact PRO-QINF-3005 SAP v1.0 downloaded and reviewed; not the distinct PRO-QINF-3003 trial.

SAP plans overall80% power, one-sided alpha0.025 and joint SCR/GMT noninferiority across four strains; type-II error is allocated0.16 to SCR and0.04 to GMT. SCR margin-10 percentage points; GMT-ratio lower bound at least2/3.

SAP section6.10 specifies10 multiple imputations under MAR for the primary estimand in FAS/mFAS with Rubin pooling; additional sensitivity analyses are specified. This is a plan, not proof that the MAR assumption holds. SAP section6.11 uses joint four-strain SCR/GMT conditions, subsequent absolute SCR/SPR criteria, and fixed-sequence testing of0.5mL before0.25mL. Adequacy requires interpretation; merely listing multiple endpoints is not a positive grade.

Issuer reports favorable prior Phase2 safety/immunogenicity for the HFMD4 program. No Phase2 NCT or numerical effect was independently matched here; these qualitative supporting statements are not outcomes of this Phase3 trial.
